body.name: Legal target-changing certificate
body.construction: A certificate is \((\vartheta_0,\vartheta_1)\in\mathcal F_A(p,m)^2\) or \((\vartheta_0,\vartheta_1)\in\mathcal F_B(p)^2\) such that \(\tau(\vartheta_0)\ne\tau(\vartheta_1)\); both points must be interior only when the certified nonrigid stratum is interior.
